description: Complete three-layer reproducibility package for Colombia's Intermodal Transport Infrastructure Classification System (Sistema de Clasificación de Infraestructura de Transporte Intermodal de Colombia, SITI) — Layer 1 C1 OWL 2 DL/SKOS/SHACL semantic core, Layer 2 C2 schema-level property graph and 13 canonical recipes, Layer 3 C3 Apache Parquet/Arrow columnar lakehouse and bimodal EPSG:9377 + ENU geodesy, Waves 1-6 + DR3-4 six-paradigm ablation scripts and empirical datasets, 9 figures at 300 DPI, 8 manuscript tables, and Supplementary Appendices A-F — accompanying the ITcon Vol. 32 (2027) Q1 research article.
journal_title: Journal of Information Technology in Construction (ITcon)
